Command object structure:

IMPORTANT: The text inside "keystrokes" will be used completely verbatim as keystrokes. Write commands exactly as you want them sent to the terminal:
- You must end every command with a newline (\n) or it will not execute.
- For special key sequences, use tmux-style escape sequences:

The "duration" attribute specifies the number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (default: 1.0) before the next command will be executed. On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

import yfinance as yf
import datetime

ticker = yf.Ticker('NVDA')

# End of quarter dates
quarter_dates = ['2023-03-31', '2023-06-30', '2023-09-30', '2023-12-31',
                 '2024-03-31', '2024-06-30', '2024-09-30', '2024-12-31']

print('Stock Prices at quarter end:')
for qd in quarter_dates:
    try:
        hist = ticker.history(period='max')
        # Get close price for that date
        price = hist.loc[hist.index >= qd].iloc[0]['Close']
        print(f'{qd}: ${price:.2f}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{qd}: Error - {e}')

print('\nInfo:')
info = ticker.info
print(f'Shares Outstanding: {info.get("sharesOutstanding", "N/A")}')
print(f'Float Shares: {info.get("floatShares", "N/A")}')
PYEOF

import requests

    data = resp.json()
    filings = data.get('filings', {}).get('recent', {}).get('accessionNumbers', [])
    print(f'Found {len(filings)} recent filings')
    for acc in filings[:20]:
        print(acc)
except Exception as e:

import requests

headers = {

}

# Parse NVDA from the Vanguard Q3 2024 filing
url = 'https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/102909/000175272424248565/13F_0000102909_20240930.xml'
resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=60)

text = resp.text
# Find all infoTable elements containing NVIDIA
import re
# Split by infoTable tags
tables = re.split(r'</?infoTable>', text)
nvda_holdings = []
for table in tables:
    if 'NVIDIA CORPORATION' in table:
        # Extract key fields
        issuer = re.search(r'<nameOfIssuer>(.*?)</nameOfIssuer>', table)
        shares = re.search(r'<sshPrnamt>(\d+)', table)
        shares_type = re.search(r'<sshPrnamtType>(.*?)</sshPrnamtType>', table)
        value = re.search(r'<value>(\d+)', table)
        cusip = re.search(r'<cusip>(.*?)</cusip>', table)
        title = re.search(r'<titleOfClass>(.*?)</titleOfClass>', table)
        sole = re.search(r'<Sole>(\d+)', table)
        shared = re.search(r'<Shared>(\d+)', table)
        nvda_holdings.append({
            'issuer': issuer.group(1) if issuer else None,
            'shares': int(shares.group(1)) if shares else None,

            'sole': int(sole.group(1)) if sole else 0,
            'shared': int(shared.group(1)) if shared else 0,
        })

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import re

headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)', 'From': 'contact@test.com'}

# Get BlackRock 13F filings - try their common CIK
cik_searches = [
    ('BlackRock Inc', '0001086360'),
    ('BlackRock Advisers', '0000913282'),
    ('FMR LLC', '0000315066'),
    ('State Street', '0000093751'),
    ('Geode Capital', '0001214717'),
]

for name, cik in cik_searches:
    print(f'\n=== {name} (CIK: {cik}) ===')
    url = f'https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK={cik}&type=13F-HR&dateb=&owner=include&count=12'
    resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=15)
    if resp.status_code == 200:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'html.parser')
        tables = soup.find_all('table')
        if tables:
            rows = tables[0].find_all('tr')
            if len(rows) > 5:
                for row in rows[1:6]:
                    cells = row.find_all(['td','th'])
                    if len(cells) >= 4:
                        desc = cells[2].get_text(strip=True)
                        fdate = cells[3].get_text(strip=True)
                        acc_match = re.search(r'Acc-no: (\S+)', desc)
                        acc = acc_match.group(1) if acc_match else ''
                        yr = int(fdate.split('-')[0]) if '-' in fdate else 0
                        mn = int(fdate.split('-')[1]) if '-' in fdate else 0
                        if yr <= 2023 and mn <= 5: qtr = '2023Q1'
                        elif yr <= 2023 and mn <= 8: qtr = '2023Q2'
                        elif yr <= 2023 and mn <= 11: qtr = '2023Q3'
                        elif yr <= 2024 and mn <= 2: qtr = '2023Q4'
                        elif yr <= 2024 and mn <= 5: qtr = '2024Q1'
                        elif yr <= 2024 and mn <= 8: qtr = '2024Q2'
                        elif yr <= 2024 and mn <= 11: qtr = '2024Q3'
                        elif yr <= 2025 and mn <= 2: qtr = '2024Q4'
                        else: qtr = '?'
                        acc_clean = acc.replace('-', '')
                        subdir = acc_clean[:8]
                        print(f'  {qtr} | acc={acc} | date={fdate} | subdir={subdir}')
